csv_project_name: Engineer for SR 682/Luhrig- Armitage Rd Intersection Improve
csv_agency: City of Athens Engineering & Public Works
csv_scope_of_work: Engieering Services for preparation of construction contract plans for the State Route 682/LuhrigArmitage Road intersection improvement in the City of Athens with a project length of approximately 1500 feet. The proposed roadway project is Phase II of the State Route 682 / State Route 56 Intersection Improvement project. It aims to support the safe movement of pedestrians and bikeway users from the newly developed housing area (Kershaw Greene) and connect them to the existing city infrastructure to the east. The project includes the addition of a roundabout at the State Route 682/ Luhrig-Armitage Road intersection, a shared use path extension from development to railroad, new sidewalk, and curb and gutter.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, EIA/EIR/EIS, Structural Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering
